sources.attribution: Per file: repo_name, path, blob_id, revision_id, detected_licenses, url (raw.githubusercontent). Full census: license_type=permissive on 100%; `license` string present on 99.58% (2,300 files empty); 86 distinct SPDX tokens, MIT 68.4%, Apache-2.0 18.0%, BSD-3-Clause 4.9%, BSD-2-Clause 1.9%, Unlicense 1.5%, CC0 0.7%, plus a long tail that includes BSD-4-Clause, BSD-4-Clause-UC, MIT-advertising, OpenSSL, Artistic-2.0, MS-PL, Python-2.0, PHP-3.0 (Blue Oak membership of these NOT verified today; only 14 identifiers were checked against the list). Feeds Q-2.

libretexts: 735 rows are GFDL (no version given) and 3 rows CC BY-SA 2.5; the registry `identifiers` for libretexts list neither, while `allowed_document_licenses` admits GFDL. Payload must carry the GFDL text; registry identifiers should be corrected in a registry PR (not in this branch).
